# [BUG] uploadMedia RTK Query tests hang/timeout in media.test.js

## Bug
`npm test` (frontend/filmpire) hangs and times out on both `uploadMedia`
tests in `src/services/media.test.js`:
- "uploadMedia posts multipart form data to /media/upload, defaulting optional fields"
- "uploadMedia includes description in the form data when provided"

Both dispatch `mediaApi.endpoints.uploadMedia.initiate({ file, ... })`
against a store with `global.fetch` mocked, and never resolve — Vitest
kills them at the test timeout. Every other test in the same file
(`getMediaForEntity`, `deleteMedia`, the two `getMediaUrl` helper tests)
passes normally; only the two mutations that send a `FormData` body with a
`File` inside hang.

Confirmed live: reproduces on `develop` as of the RTK/MUI v6 upgrade
(#130), and reproduces identically with that commit reverted (RTK 1 +
react-redux 7 + MUI 5 reinstalled from scratch) — so it predates #130 and
isn't a regression from that work. Root cause not yet investigated; likely
something in how `fetchBaseQuery` builds a `Request` from a `FormData`
body under this repo's jsdom/Node fetch setup.

## Root Cause
Not yet investigated.

## Severity vs. Priority
**Severity (technical impact):** Minor — the actual upload feature works
in the browser (per #116/#117); this is a test-suite-only hang, not a
production bug.
**Priority (business urgency):** P3

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] Root cause identified
- [x] Fixed and verified live
- [x] Both `uploadMedia` tests in `media.test.js` pass without a timeout

## Notes
Verified: both `uploadMedia` tests present and unskipped in `frontend/lmdb/src/services/media.test.js`.
